label: Moxa EDS-4012-8P-4GS-LVA-T
description: Moxa EDS-4012-8P-4GS-LVA-T - 12-port managed Fast Ethernet PoE switch: eight 10/100BaseT(X) PoE ports (802.3af/at/bt, 90 W each, 240 W total budget) and four 100/1000BaseSFP cages. 13.34 W without PoE load, 48 VDC input.

poe.note: The -LVA build declares 240 W for total PD power consumption at 48 VDC input; the -LVB build declares 180 W at 48 V, 150 W at 24 V (120 W on the -T build) and 62 W at 12 V. This spec is the -LVA, so 240 W. Every PoE port is an 802.3af (PoE), 802.3at (PoE+) and 802.3bt (PoE++) PSE port rated 90 W maximum per port on the datasheet, so 8 ports declare 720 W of port capability against a 240 W budget - the budget is the binding number, not the port count. PoE+ output wants more than 52 VDC on the input; the -LVA module takes 44 to 57 VDC, the -LVB module 12 to 57 VDC.

notes: Switch properties, from the same datasheet: 16 K MAC table, 9.216 KB jumbo frames, 256 VLANs (VID 1 to 4094), 512 IGMP groups, 4 priority queues, 1 MB packet buffer. Console is a front-panel RS-232 8-pin RJ45 at 115200 n 8 1 (TxD, RxD, GND) - not modelled as an interface, because a console carries no frames. One alarm relay (1 A @ 24 VDC) and one digital input, a USB Type A port marked Reserved, IP40 metal case on DIN rail, wall-mount kit optional. Power comes from a removable module: PWR-100-LV (9.6 to 60 VDC, redundant dual inputs on the -LV models) or PWR-105-HV-I (88 to 300 VDC / 85 to 264 VAC, single input), which is why the ordering name carries the module (-LV/-HV) and the chassis name does not. The datasheet publishes no switching-capacity or forwarding-rate figure at all, so no fabric is declared here rather than a number guessed from the port count. All eight copper ports are PSE ports; the four SFP cages are not. Consumption 13.34 W with no PoE load (15.32 W for -LVB). 827 g, 55 x 140 x 120 mm, -40 to 75 C. Firmware for the whole EDS-4000/EDS-G4000 family is Moxa's next-generation switch OS v4.x, listed as firmware v4.2 (2026-03-20) on the series download page (https://www.moxa.com/en/products/industrial-network-infrastructure/ethernet-switches/layer-2-managed-switches/eds-4012-series).
